title: Fix Invisible Shulker Heads
description: Fixes the bug in earlier versions of Minecraft where the Shulker head is visible when the Shulker entity should be invisible.
body:
Fixes the bug in earlier versions of Minecraft (1.20.1) where the Shulker head is visible when the Shulker entity should be invisible.

Should work with other resource packs.

Requires Traben's EMF and ETF mods to work.
